messages.subject: Plot_genoprob colours
parts:
Hi Karl,

Thanks for your help previously.

I have been using the function plot_genoprob() to generate representations of founder allele probabilities for a cohort of DO mice. I am able to adjust the colours within the grayscale (as shown in attached image), although would like to colour each row by the associated collaborative cross colour (i.e. all of row A has differing intensities of yellow while all of row B has differing intensities of grey and so on).

Do you know if this is possible?

Kind regards,

Harry

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Plot_genoprob colours
parts:
I would require some heavy editing to the function. I think you’d need to have the probabilities in 8 different ranges, 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, ...  7-8, and then paste together the eight different color scales so that 0-1 would correspond to one color. 1-2 the next, 2-3 the next, etc. 

And a potential problem would be the difficulty to gauge the intensity scales of the different colors. Degrees of yellow, of light blue, and of gray, would look quite different and be hard to compare.

karl
